title: Your Tuesday Just Got Sweeter
tension: Celebrating small, everyday moments without manufactured urgency or invented scarcity—staying authentic to Joyful Indulgence while avoiding FOMO traps.
sharpenedBrief: Create one Instagram post that captures a genuine, relatable cheesecake moment—mid-week treat, friend hangout, or solo indulgence—using direct address and sensory language. Showcase an existing Cake Me product with warm, playful copy that invites audience into the community of happiness-makers. No discounts, no invented offers; let the product and moment do the talking.

questions.q: Which everyday moment feels most shareable to your audience right now—a weekday break, a friend gathering, or a personal indulgence ritual?
questions.solvingFor: Scene selection and emotional hook for the post
questions.why: Brand Core Pillar 'Memorable Experiences' + JTBD 'Give me an easy and special way to celebrate a moment, big or small' clarifies that scale of celebration is flexible.

questions.q: Should the caption use 'tú' direct address or 'nosotros' community language as the primary voice?
questions.solvingFor: Tone and intimacy level of the copy
questions.why: SIGNATURES list both: 'Addressing the audience directly with tú and using nosotros to build a sense of community'—this post must choose one lead voice.

refusals: Discounts, limited-time offers, or invented scarcity language
Generic 'treat yourself' messaging without emotional specificity
Aggressive sales language or high-pressure FOMO
Claims about product exclusivity or brand superiority
